verdict.rationale: Numeral documents a broad API covering products, calculations, transactions, refunds, refund reversals, merchants/platform calculations, and exemption certificate requests and certificates. Its first-party MCP server also exposes nexus, filings, and registrations to agents. However, nothing claims full API–UI parity: API keys are obtained from the Dashboard, and dashboard features such as tax mail monitoring, autoregistration, and VAT ID validation have no documented API endpoints. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented REST endpoints for filings, registrations, nexus, mailbox and VAT validation, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent corroboration.
